item.arsenalorbital.orbital_designator.t: Right-click while aiming at a block.
Press H to choose the weapon. You are invulnerable during the cinematic.
message.arsenalorbital.no_target: No target: aim at a block (out of range)
message.arsenalorbital.busy: AEGIS-7 is already on a mission
weapon.arsenalorbital.satellite.desc: The giant AEGIS-7 satellite wakes up, charges its particle cannon and fires a beam that drills down to bedrock.
weapon.arsenalorbital.phobos.desc: Travel to Mars. A missile hits Phobos, which slingshots around Mars and comes back in flames to crash on your target.
screen.arsenalorbital.weapons.hint: Tap a weapon to use it with the Orbital Designator (H to close)
weapon.arsenalorbital.blackhole.desc: Travel to Andromeda's black hole. The Anchor station rips out a singularity and sends it through a wormhole: it devours everything and collapses.
weapon.arsenalorbital.star.desc: The biggest attack: a trip to the middle of nowhere. Prometheus station drains a blue hypergiant and fires a laser across the universe. Lasts 3 min 30 s.
